command:
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- OS ---'
sed -n '1,6p' /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- BOOT ID ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- NGINX PACKAGE ---'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Status} ${Version}\n' nginx 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- NGINX STATE ---'
systemctl is-enabled nginx 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl is-active nginx 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- LISTENER ---'

printf '%s\n' '--- HTTP ---'
curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /dev/null -w 'http_code=%{http_code}\n' --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP/" || true

command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'BOOT_ID='
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'PACKAGE='
dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version} ${Status}\n' nginx
nginx -t
printf 'ENABLED='
systemctl is-enabled nginx
printf 'ACTIVE='
systemctl is-active nginx
printf '%s\n' 'LISTENER:'
ss -ltnp '( sport = :80 )'
printf 'PAGE_SHA256='
sha256sum /var/www/html/index.nginx-debian.html | awk '{print $1}'
http_code=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /tmp/nginx-baseline-body -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP/")
printf 'HTTP_CODE=%s\n' "$http_code"
test "$http_code" = 200
printf 'HTTP_BODY_SHA256='
sha256sum /tmp/nginx-baseline-body | awk '{print $1}'
printf '%s\n' 'HTTP_HEADERS:'
curl --noproxy '*' -sS -I --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP/" | sed -n '1,5p'

test "$http_code" = 200
